info.title: CodeReach
info.description: Roslyn MCP server for ASP.NET Core and C# solutions. Answers which endpoints and background jobs reach a piece of code, and what a git diff affects, from a compiler-accurate, persistent call graph.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: codereach: which endpoints and jobs reach this code, and what does your diff affect.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: codereach [serve]                    run as an MCP server on stdio (the default)

options.name: --solution
options.description: a .slnx, .sln or .csproj, or a directory holding exactly one (default: current directory)

options.name: --config
options.description: configuration file (default: codereach.json beside the solution)

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: where the index snapshot is kept (default: the user's local application data)
